mapper.insert: INSERT INTO WOW_PAYMENT ( WOW_PAYMENT_NO, WOW_MEMBERSHIP_NO, MEMBER_NO, PAYMENT_METHOD_NO, PAYMENT_AMOUNT, PAYMENT_DATE, PAYMENT_STATUS, PAYMENT_TYPE ) VALUES ( SEQ_WOW_PAYMENT_NO.NEXTVAL, #{wowMembershipNo}, #{memberNo}, #{paymentMethodNo}, #{amount}, SYSDATE, #{paymentStatus}, #{paymentType} )
mapper.update: UPDATE WOW_MEMBERSHIP SET STATUS = 'CANCEL_PENDING', AUTO_PAYMENT_YN = 'N', CANCEL_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE MEMBER_NO = #{memberNo} AND STATUS = 'ACTIVE'
